Bahasa Indonesia: berawan
Example: It is cloudy this morning.

cards.back:

Bahasa Indonesia: angin
Example: The wind is strong.

With a lot of wind.
Bahasa Indonesia: berangin
Example: It is windy, so we fly kites.

cards.back:
Very warm.
Bahasa Indonesia: panas
Example: The sun is hot.
